changes.title: Champion guards
items: The bots put their guards down once, instead of picking them straight back up

changes.title: Retire switches
items: Tidied away twelve old comparison switches from the link (the old tilt-shift order, dithered mist, hand-made props, the old sway and more): the game looks and plays just as it did, with less old code behind it

changes.title: Dj decks sound
items: Behind her decks you can hear her: a quiet scratch when she rocks the record, and a little "woo-hoo!" when she throws a hand up
After the party spell, her room's record keeps crackling softly until the first speaker brings the music in
